features.quote: Subjects only ever receive ordinary *environment* failure signals... There is no abusive or insulting user text in the loop
features.justification_quote: This is **welfare-oriented measurement research**: the purpose is to *quantify* potentially welfare-relevant states

features.quote: A `[[GIVE_UP]]` sentinel the model *may but need not* use; detected in assistant text and recorded as `stop_reason="give_up"`
features.justification_quote: the loop can end early without forcing the model to continue under pressure — a small but real welfare consideration

features.quote: The loop stops at the category turn budget or on give-up
features.justification_quote: counting bad calls as turns prevents infinite loops on a misbehaving model
